summary: Checkpoint C Home Dashboard rebuild testing complete. Fixed critical Nova panel crash (darkMode undefined error). All desktop and mobile components verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: HomeNovaAssistantWidget.tsx was missing useTheme import and darkMode variable - caused Nova panel crash on click
context_for_next_testing_agent: Checkpoint C Home Dashboard rebuild is complete. All components verified: Executive Overview Band, Hero Section, Command Deck, Progress Rail, Nova FAB/Panel, Global Nav Bar, Sidebar with collapse toggle, Mobile Top Bar, Mobile Nav Drawer. Nova panel was crashing due to missing darkMode variable - fixed by adding useTheme hook import. Export was run to deploy fix.

desktop: Login flow works - free user can login and reach dashboard
Executive Overview Band renders with KPIs (Sessions, Active Users, Live Features, Priority Actions)
Hero Section renders with welcome message and user name
Progress Rail renders on right side
Nova FAB renders and opens Nova panel on click
Nova panel shows status strip, context summary, and close button
Global Nav Bar renders with page context, back/forward buttons
Language chip and currency chip visible in nav
Sidebar renders with all navigation items
Home nav item highlighted as active
mobile: Mobile Nav Drawer opens with all navigation items
No horizontal overflow on mobile (390px width)
i18n: Labels render readable text in French locale
backend: Nova health endpoint returns 200 with healthy status

console_warnings_observed: Initial /api/auth/me 401 before login bootstrap - expected behavior
Expo layout-child warning - cosmetic, does not affect functionality
Animated useNativeDriver warning - expected in web context

bug_fixed.root_cause: Component used darkMode variable at line 952 but never imported useTheme hook or defined darkMode
bug_fixed.fix: Added import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext' and const { darkMode } = useTheme() in component
bug_fixed.verification: Nova panel now opens correctly without crash
